headline: Equatorial Guinea's 2024 tax code (in force 2025) cut the top rate on wages from 35 % to 25 % and raised the exempt band to 1.4 M FCFA, but moved the 20 % expense deduction into an optional return: without it a 3.6 M FCFA wage pays 220.000 instead of 188.000
